label: Some concrete individual exists at w and at every world accessible from w…, from actual grounded
description: Classical conditional with excluded middle as an explicit premise, zero Lean axioms: inhabitedness, restricted well-foundedness and 'every actual contingent concretum has an actual concrete ground' give a concrete individual existing at every accessible world. The third premise rejects the root horn and needs its own defence. All three non-logical premises are open; no root change.
